verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party feature that generates or edits a Trigger.dev workflow or task from a natural-language prompt. The MCP server's documented tools cover searching docs, initializing projects, triggering, deploying and monitoring, not authoring task code. Skills are instruction sets that help third-party AI coding assistants write the code, and prompt templates are LLM prompts used inside tasks. All of these are adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt
